newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian council speaker wins second term.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian council speaker wins second term.

text.p: Palestinian lawmakers on Thursday re-elected Palestinian Legislative Council speaker Ahmed Korei, better known as Abu Alaa, to a second term, council officials said.

"Abu Alaa was elected president of the council for a second term with 62 votes," Faraj al-Sarraf, a council member who chaired the meeting, said in a live broadcast on the Voice of Palestine radio station.
Sheikh Suleiman al-Roumi, an independent Islamist member of the 88-member council from Rafah, received 14 votes. The council also elected two deputies and a secretary-general.
Korei was elected speaker of the council after the first Palestinian general elections in 1996.
The council was set up under Israeli-PLO self-rule deals as a parliament for the Palestinian Authority during an interim period of negotiations which under the agreement should end in 1999.
